title: window_test_runs/<time>/meta.json
description: Where a run of the window models over a test set came from.

test_run.description: The test run the instant scores, the rule hits and the attacks came from.

window_thresholds.description: The directory the window models' thresholds came from.

window_scores.description: The window scores of the test set, written as the test set was scored.

models.description: The directory the instant models' weights came from, as the test run records it.

onnx_files.description: The ONNX files the instant models scored as, as the test run records them. Null when they scored in torch.

scores.description: The instant scores of the test set, as the test run records them.

window_models.description: The directory the window models came from.

window_onnx_files.description: The ONNX files the window models scored as, as the window thresholds record them. Null when they scored in torch.

test_set.description: The test set the rows came from.

log_split.description: The log split the test set was drawn on.

grid.description: The grid the split was cut from.

min_speed.description: The speed a row had to exceed to be counted.

rows.description: How many attacked rows were read.

attacks.description: How many attacks were injected into the test logs.

attacks_worth_catching.description: How many of them reach a row above `min_speed` and moved it by at least the test run's `moved`.

hours.description: Hours of rows above `min_speed` with no attack in them, what the false positive alarms are counted over.
